newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rice prices seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rice prices seen steady.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are expected to remain steady because of the year-end holiday season, dealers said on Thursday

The state-run Rice Export Corporation, which had received 10 bids on Tuesday for the sale and export of 40,000/45,000 tonnes OF IRRI-6 rice at between $238 and $360 per tonne CIF, is likely to take a decision in the next few days, one dealer said.
Rice exports rose to 116,980 tonnes worth $35 million in November from 73,593 worth $25 million in October.
Exports between July and November rose to 435,171 tonnes from 421,278 in the year-ago period.
